INSTAGRAM
Use Claude as a tutor, not an answer machine. The prompt that makes it teach instead of tell.

Getting answers is not learning. If Claude does the thinking, you remember nothing by tomorrow.
Slide 3 is the tutor prompt. Fill in your topic and what you already know.
Slide 6 is a 7-day plan: one topic, one week.

Save this one, and follow for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
